an4.204:1.1: vo bhikkhave desessāmi asappurisena asappurisatarañ ca
an4.204:1.2: sappurisañ ca sappurisena sappurisatarañ ca, taṃ suṇātha . . . pe . . . 2.
an4.204:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco pāṇātipāti hoti, . . . pe . . . samphappalāpī hoti, abhijjhālū hoti, vyāpannacitto hoti, micchadiṭṭhiko hoti.
an4.204:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā ca pāṇātipāti hoti parañ ca pāṇātipāte samādapeti . . . pe . . . attanā ca abhijjhālū hoti parañ ca abhijjhāya samādapeti,
an4.204:3.3: attanā ca vyāpannacitto hoti parañ ca vyāpāde samādapeti, attanā ca micchādiṭṭhiko hoti parañ ca micchādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti.
an4.204:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti . . . pe . . . anabhijjhālū hoti, avyāpannacitto hoti, sammādiṭṭhiko hoti.
an4.204:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco attanā ca pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti parañ ca pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, . . . pe . . . attanā ca anabhijjhālū hoti parañ ca anabhijjhāya samādapeti,
an4.204:5.3: attanā ca avyāpannacitto hoti parañ ca avyāpāde samādapeti,
an4.204:5.4: attanā ca sammādiṭṭhiko hoti parañ ca sammādiṭṭhiyā samādapeti.
an4.204:5.5: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhave sappurisena sappurisataro. 205. 1. Asappurisañ
